content:
#23 Dear all,
just to add a data point to the MathML discussion: there is significant movement on the MathML Front

a) There is a native MathML implementation under way for Chromium (see https://mathml.igalia.com/news/2019/02/12/launch-of-the-project/#new) and the Igalia people know what they are doing (and Google supports this)

b) There is a MathML refresh community group at https://www.w3.org/community/mathml4/ that discusses and tries to resolve remaining implementation issues

c) MathJax has two functionalities: TeX2MathML (nLab does not need this, it has iTeX and MathML presentation in all browsers. The latter is important until a) happens (ETA 12 months) After that, native MathML rendering (as we currently have it in FireFox) is vastly faster and superior in quality.

Michael Kohlhase (waiting for an account)
